smap.product_title: SMAP Enhanced L3 Radiometer Global Daily 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture
notes: SMAP L3 enhanced measures SURFACE soil moisture (top ~5 cm) only; it contains no root-zone soil moisture. Root-zone values would require a model-derived Level 4 product.
Each 9 km cell mixes many fields, roads, channels and urban patches: treat every value as a regional indication, not a field measurement.
Only retrievals flagged recommended quality (retrieval_qual_flag 0 or 8) and located on land are accepted; rejected observations are kept with their reason codes.

notes: NDVI indicates vegetation greenness and canopy condition; it is not a measurement of soil health, crop identity or soil fertility.
A 500 m pixel covers about 25 hectares and mixes many small fields, so a single value is not a field measurement.
16-day composites trade temporal detail for fewer cloudy/missing observations; each composite keeps its pixel reliability and VI quality bits.
Overlapping sinusoidal tiles report the same composite more than once; only the best-quality record per composite period is kept (see summary.n_duplicate_records_dropped).
`series` is the single pixel at the site (often the town centre); `regional_series` is the median of usable pixels in a ~15 km box and is what the timeline check uses.

limitations: The expected calendar comes from the demo-site preset history, not from the farmer's field records; a mismatch can be late sowing, a second crop, weeds or irrigation.
A 500 m NDVI pixel mixes many fields, so it cannot confirm what is growing on this field.
NDVI is a greenness indicator, not a measurement of soil health, crop identity or yield.
16-day composites smooth the season and blur short fallow gaps.
timeline_check.basis: median of usable 500 m pixels in a ~15 km box
